lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters organized into a regular grid pattern of approximately five vertical columns and six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a coordinate-like grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a high density of small spots, with a specific semi-circular cluster of spots located at the anterior base of the fin.
